احتسين (form VIII)
# اِحْتَسَيْنَ (iḥtasayna) /iħ.ta.saj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَسَى (iḥtasā)
# اُحْتُسِينَ (uḥtusīna) /uħ.tu.siː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَسَى (iḥtasā)
# اِحْتَسِينَ (iḥtasīna) /iħ.ta.siː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِحْتَسَى (iḥtasā)
